subject: general
question: Who founded the All-India Forward Bloc Party?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhas Chandra Bose**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subhas Chandra Bose** founded the All-India Forward Bloc Party.
 
• The All-India Forward Bloc was formed on **3rd May 1939**, as a faction within the Indian National Congress.
 
• Bose aimed to consolidate the political left and to rally all radical elements within the Congress under one banner.
 
• He sought to establish a socialist state in India and believed in armed struggle against British colonial rule.
 
• The Forward Bloc played a significant role in the Indian independence movement, especially during the Quit India Movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subhas Chandra Bose** was a prominent freedom fighter and a nationalist leader who advocated for complete independence from British rule.
 
• He was elected as the President of the Indian National Congress twice, in **1938** and **1939**.
 
• After differences with Mahatma Gandhi and other Congress leaders, Bose resigned from the Congress presidency and formed the Forward Bloc.
 
• He later went on to lead the Indian National Army (INA) to fight against the British during World War II.
 
• Bose's legacy continues to be remembered and honored in India for his uncompromising patriotism and his efforts towards India's independence.
